annotation.justification: The clause clearly distinguishes between origin servers and other servers, specifying that origin servers can use any normalization method while other servers must use scheme-based normalization. The reference to Section 6.2.3 of [RFC3986] provides a concrete method for normalization, and there is no language that permits multiple materially different interpretations. The wording is precise and does not introduce ambiguity.
